story.title: Matatu fares climb as fuel prices bite
story.dek: Commuters on three busy routes are paying a fifth more than they did last month, operators say.
story.body:
Fares on three of Nairobi busiest matatu routes have risen by about a fifth in four weeks, according to operators and a survey of stage prices.

Operators blame the pump price and the cost of spare parts. Commuters say the increase has already changed how far they travel for work.
